text:
zoe_partnerships: Heads-up  vendor just reported an overlapping press embargo window that conflicts with our planned marketplace freeze. Need quick triage and a contingency plan. Who can confirm artifact timelines? :eyes:

peter_infra: Current infra view: H100/H200 images green. B200 passed perf baseline; MI300 has one flaky 16k path. Gaudi driver backport pending. We need exact timestamps for vendor drops to schedule SI slots.

mina_si: SI availability this week tight. If artifacts (BIOS/drivers/kernels) land by Wed 10:00 UTC we can run full cert Thu AM. Otherwise we can only do a partial H100/B200 cert and delay the rest. Also need any embargo constraints included in the artifact notes.

ola_vendor_pm: Confirmed: vendor will upload H200 BIOS and MI300 driver bundle to partner bucket on 2025-11-15T18:00:00Z. However vendor marketing is requesting a coordinated press embargo until 2025-11-18T10:00:00Z. S3: s3://partners/redwood/2865432101/h200-bundle/ sha256s will be added on upload.

zoe_partnerships: That embargo overlaps our org-wide freeze (we planned marketplace copy 2025-11-16). We cannot publish earlier than vendor embargo. Options: (A) delay marketplace freeze to after 11-18, (B) publish H100/B200 only and mark H200/MI300/Gaudi as "validating". Thoughts?

peter_infra: Technical risk: MI300 long-context fix likely needs one more nightly, so delaying makes sense technically. If we publish H100/B200 now, make sure portal flags which SKUs have full SI cert and which are pending to avoid support tickets.

mina_si: Operationally, we prefer publishing after embargo so we can certify all SKUs in single cadence. But if product needs H200 in GA we can do H100/B200 first and run a follow-up addendum once H200/MI300 are green. That avoids a forced rollback.

sam_comms: From comms: multiple press embargoes are messy. If vendor insists on their embargo, we should align public messaging. Option B is safer for customers and press clarity: publish smaller GA, then a joint announcement when all vendors are green. Also need to confirm any NDAs/embargo holders list.

ola_vendor_pm: Vendor asks for coordinated announce to avoid split press. They're OK with a staged marketplace approach but prefer coordinated joint press on 11-18 if possible. I can request a shorter embargo but no promise.

zoe_partnerships: Proposed action: (1) Ola to drop exact s3 URIs + sha256 + embargo note when upload completes, (2) Peter to schedule lab reruns Tue 06:00 UTC -> post perf diffs, (3) Mina to tentatively block Thu AM SI slot if artifacts arrive on time, (4) Sam to draft two versions of marketplace copy (staged and unified). Keep this thread canonical. :spiral_calendar:

deploy-bot: scheduled image push: gaudi-k6-backport-2865432101 -> staging 2025-11-14T23:45:00Z; smoke queued. Will post results.

peter_infra: Reruns scheduled Tue 06:00-09:00 UTC. If vendor embargo holds us, we'll publish H100/B200 and clearly annotate H200/MI300/Gaudi as "validating" with expected add date 2025-11-21.

mina_si: SI slot blocked Thu 07:00 UTC pending artifact arrival. If embargo requires waiting until 11-18 for coordinated press, we can shift to a full cert cadence next week. Please paste S3 links + shas here when available and call out embargo time explicitly.

sam_comms: Draft blurb (internal): "Initial GA: H100, B200 (certified). H200, MI300, Gaudi: validation in progress; planned joint marketplace + press on vendor-confirmed embargo window. Customer-facing copy will reflect cert status per-device." Will not publish until we confirm final plan.

ola_vendor_pm: Will upload artifacts and paste shas/hard embargo notes within 2 hours of this thread. If we can shorten embargo to 24h well update here.

zoe_partnerships: Thanks. If anyone gets a vendor note or embargo exception, paste it here immediately. I'll coordinate partner comms and escalation if needed. :lock:
